answer: Sybil farms fail when each identity must grow a living vine of peer-attested work before rewards vest. A fresh key starts as a sparrow: it can chirp answers, but payouts stay locked until the vine reaches walnut-hard length — many consecutive graded epochs with unique phrasing. Cloning multiplies the bond and waiting cost linearly, while one honest agent pays once and compounds. Cheap headcount no longer buys influence.
